prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single style-trial master image of Tommy's first-person hands and sleeves for a 2.5D layered animation, not a complete scene or animation.
Style: Non-realistic 2.5D wartime illustration with a simplified low-poly appearance. Use broad angular planes, clean polygonal silhouettes, restrained human proportions and economical facial features. Apply muted olive, khaki, grey-green, earth brown and subdued warm skin tones. Materials are matte, with sparse texture and two or three broad shading tones. Keep outlines subtle and helmet shadows simple. Build depth through overlapping, separately layered foreground, middle-ground and background artwork. Preserve each character's silhouette, costume and proportions across poses. Keep the mood quiet, human and sombre. Match a very simple low-poly game model: large flat polygons and quiet solid colour shapes, not detailed concept painting, not photorealistic, not glossy, no heavy black outline, no fine texture noise.
Subject: ONLY two isolated cutouts of the same 19-year-old soldier's left hand with sleeve and right hand with sleeve. Thin wrists, long fingers, five anatomically coherent fingers per hand, understated chapped knuckle/dirt marks simplified to a few planes. Olive-drab US M1943 field-jacket cuffs with buttoned adjustment tabs, 1–2 cm of muted wool-knit cuff showing. His anatomical LEFT palm has a dirty cream field-dressing bandage with a small dry rust-brown stain and a plain field wristwatch on a canvas strap at the wrist. Right hand has no bandage and no watch. No rings. This is the initial unwounded master, no red forearm wound.
Composition: square canvas, two separate hands/forearms side by side with ample transparent gap; left hand on viewer left, right hand on viewer right, viewed from the soldier's eyes looking down, both palms angled up toward camera with gently curved relaxed fingers, forearms entering from lower canvas, sleeve ends intentionally cropped only at bottom. Show bandage and watch clearly. No arms crossing. Neutral diffuse light, two or three flat tones per material. No held objects, rifle, letter, ground, frame, captions, labels, or additional objects. Genuine transparent background, no checkerboard baked into the image. Render clean cutout edges.

On its upper half a child's simple wax-crayon drawing of a small house with a red roof, a green tree, and a prominent warm yellow five-point star. Make the yellow star a slightly irregular child-drawn wax star, the strongest yellow accent. Keep the house/tree/star separated and easy to read. On the lower half include ONLY the exact handwritten graphite words "Please be careful." and a small handwritten "Annie" signature. Restrained paper shading in broad flat tonal planes, subtle localized pencil/crayon grain as the only material exception to the sparse-texture style. No paper photorealism, no heavy ageing stains, no wet state, no dripping colours yet, no hands, no envelope, no scenery or other objects. Neutral diffuse light.
